The named grain-bank example and joint-programme geography add local context, but no supported climate→violence or reverse insecurity-to-adaptation mechanism was retrieved.

executive_assessment.text: The July 2026 WFP account documents differentiated food-access burdens and a women-managed grain bank in Uriles Pinalón, Jalapa; one case does not establish prevalence across the Dry Corridor.
The UN programme identifies seven target municipalities and intended food/water resilience capacities. Targets are not achieved results; the IPC estimate retained here is historical and national.
